options.name: directory
options.description: Path to the source directory to install the Rust package from. This is only used when installing packages.

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to the C(cargo) installed in the system. If not specified, the module looks for C(cargo) in E(PATH).

options.name: features
options.description: List of features to activate. This is only used when installing packages.

options.name: locked
options.description: Install with locked dependencies. This is only used when installing packages.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of a Rust package to install.

options.name: path
options.description: The base path where to install the Rust packages. Cargo automatically appends V(/bin). In other words, V(/usr/local) becomes V(/usr/local/bin).

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the Rust package.

options.name: version
options.description: The version to install. If O(name) contains multiple values, the module tries to install all of them in this version.
